description: Scrape Amazon's Today's Deals grid. Filter by category, brand, rating, price and discount range across Amazon marketplaces.

brand.description: Free-text filter matched against each deal's brand name (case-insensitive substring, e.g. `Anker`, `Samsung`). Leave empty for all brands.
brand.title: Brand

category.description: Free-text filter matched against each deal's department/category name (case-insensitive substring, e.g. `Electronics`, `Home`, `Toys`). Leave empty for all categories.
category.title: Category / department

dealType.description: Only emit deals belonging to this collection bubble (the real filter chips Amazon shows atop the Deals page). Department-scoped bubbles (e.g. Customers' Most-Loved) are enforced by matching each deal's department IDs; tag-scoped bubbles (Lightning Deals, Coupons, Outlet) can't be verified per-deal from the grid data and pass through unfiltered. `(any deal type)` applies no filter.
dealType.title: Deal type

discountMax.description: Drop deals with a savings percentage above this value.
discountMax.title: Max discount %

discountMin.description: Drop deals with a savings percentage below this value.
discountMin.title: Min discount %

marketplace.description: Which Amazon domain's Today's Deals page to scrape.
marketplace.title: Amazon marketplace

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted deal records.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPages.description: Hard cap on how many grid pages (up to 30 items each) to walk (each page is a fresh in-browser fetch of the widget's own pagination request).
maxPages.title: Max pages

minRating.description: Only emit deals with a star rating at or above this value. Deals without a visible rating pass through unless this is set.
minRating.title: Minimum star rating (1-5)

priceMax.description: Drop deals priced above this amount (in the marketplace's local currency).
priceMax.title: Max deal price

priceMin.description: Drop deals priced below this amount (in the marketplace's local currency).
priceMin.title: Min deal price

proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy used to fetch the Deals page. AUTO (datacenter) is used by default; the actor escalates to residential automatically only after repeated block detections within a run.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

title: Amazon Deals Scraper Input
